property_summary: After any successful initialize, the stored changeFee must equal the _changeFee argument passed in; the mutant stores the _feeRate argument instead, so for any input with _changeFee != uint56(_feeRate) (e.g. _feeRate <= 5000 and _changeFee different) the stored changeFee diverges.
change_summary: Replace `changeFee = _changeFee;` with `changeFee = uint56(_feeRate);` so changeFee is set from the feeRate parameter instead.
